description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/VirtualAssistants/Permissions. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Updates the VA display name, replaces per-store grants and increments the access version. ownerAgent: account-metrics. Use when: Rename a VA or change their stores or permissions without sending an invitation or interrupting access. Input: Id, current AccessVersion, optional Name (1–50 nonblank characters), Stores. Omitting Name preserves the existing name. Output: Effective from the next request; 409 on conflicting edits. Preserves the email, credentials and access state. Search terms: virtualassistants permissions. Send the exact request payload in body. Requires confirmed=true before execution.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.
